visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram: left column has 3 input nodes (circles with Σ), middle column has 3 hidden nodes (green circles with Σ), right column has 3 output nodes (orange circles with Σ). Each node feeds into a square 'f' activation box then to Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Weighted arrows connect layers labeled w_ji and w_kj. Dashed error line curves from output area back left. Purple dots on far left indicate bias inputs.
Rounded rectangle 'Input Sample' in light purple/pink with purple border, top-left
Rounded rectangle 'Target Label' in light purple/pink with purple border, top-right
Vertical red rectangle with white rotated text 'Error Error', far right edge
Green rectangles labeled Class 1, Class 2, Class m to the right of the error bar
Orange rectangles labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m at end of output layer
Bottom annotation boxes: 'For Layer "j"' (pink), 'Previous Layer (l)' (blue), 'Current Layer (You are here)' (green), 'Next Layer (K)' (orange), 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer' (pink)
Equation box bottom-left with two formulas, white background with border
Equation box bottom-right with error formula and red X X X, white background with border

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is bold, dark red, largest text. Subtitle is dark blue/purple. Body text is black. Box text varies by box color. Some labels like 'Node Bias' have circled numbers. Equations use standard math notation with subscripts.
animation_state: Static slide; no elements appear mid-build or partially revealed.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light beige (#F5E6D3). 2. Add title 'Neural Network Model' at top center in bold dark red (#8B0000), approx 40pt. 3. Add subtitle '(Weights of hidden layer AFFECT Calculated Error)' directly below title in dark blue/purple, approx 24pt. 4. Add yellow circle with '15' at top right. 5. Draw central neural network: 3 input nodes (white circles with red Σ) on left, 3 hidden nodes (green circles with red Σ) in center, 3 output nodes (orange circles with red Σ) on right. 6. Connect input to hidden with arrows labeled w_ji; connect hidden to output with arrows labeled w_kj. 7. Add square 'f' activation boxes after each node column leading to Output 1, Output 2, Output m labels. 8. Add dashed curved error arrow from output area back toward left. 9. Add purple dots on far left for bias inputs. 10. Add 'Input Sample' rounded box top-left (light purple) and 'Target Label' rounded box top-right (light purple). 11. Add vertical red bar on far right with white rotated text 'Error Error'. 12. Add green Class 1, Class 2, Class m boxes to right of error bar. 13. Add bottom annotation boxes: pink 'For Layer "j"', blue 'Previous Layer (l)', green 'Current Layer (You are here)', orange 'Next Layer (K)', pink 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer'. 14. Add bottom-left equation box: Net_j = Σ (w_ji , O_i) / O_j = f(Net_j) = 1 / (1 + e^-Net_j). 15. Add bottom-right equation box: E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2 followed by red 'X X X'. 16. Add small labels: 'Node Bias' with circled 1 near bottom left; purple circles with '1' under hidden nodes; arrows labeled i, j, k pointing up from annotation boxes.
